details: Frames picker now searches the active picker list for exactly one tile whose aria-label equals the exact requested asset title when the option wrapper has no tile.
The alias is resolved and required to be a UUID before clicking the frame option. Missing/conflicting alias or expected-ID mismatch fails closed without changing the slot.

live_error: Flow selected references, but exact backend IDs could not be verified; no request sent.

source_finding.frame_path_before_fix: chooseNativePickerAsset searched only option.querySelector(flow-grid-tile-container), extracted/resolved the ID after clicking, then relied on FlowGenerationOperations to reject non-UUID values.
source_finding.attach_path: FlowReferenceActions.attach first searches inside the exact option, then falls back to an exact aria-label tile in document; it resolves ASB before committing chip.
source_finding.conclusion: A Frames-picker-specific tile extraction gap is the strongest source-level explanation. Current evidence does not prove whether the live alias map was missing/conflicting or whether the running Frames function differed from source.

proof: Tile outside the option wrapper resolves exact ASB alias to UUID.
Missing alias is rejected before click.
Conflicting alias mappings are rejected before click.

evidence_limits: Both saved job reports stop at the generic exact-backend-ID validation error. Neither records selectedId, alias-map entries, schema epoch, or picker tile placement, so missing alias, conflicting alias, and runtime bundle provenance cannot be distinguished from live logs.
The earlier API image attach/clear path did confirm UUID 3e54fcea-fc18-4f6e-a904-0e6259fd0347, which proves UUID resolution for the ingredient-reference picker path but not the Frames picker path.
